purpose: Independent remote read-only integrity evidence consumed by analysis/review_recovery_learning_complete_v1.py after all eight owned stages and their controller exit. This schema does not launch jobs or authorize further research.

required_receipt.adoption_sha256: Actual bytes of explicit learning parent adoption
required_receipt.verified_file_sha256: Exact final lock map, every file freshly measured and equal to its lock
required_receipt.verified_original_file_sha256: Exact adopted336 original game/metadata map, freshly measured
required_receipt.verified_runtime_file_sha256: Exact adopted9 runtime executable/package map, freshly measured
required_receipt.source_inventory: Exact current recursive gnrl/scripts/tests .py inventory matching adoption; no added executable source
required_receipt.base_inventory_sha256: Bound full model inventory file hash; actually enumerate all28 files and compare each bytes/hash, including cache metadata
required_receipt.initial_adapter_sha256: Exact full unchanged canonical initial adapter file inventory and measured hashes
required_receipt.all_models_locked_sha256: Actual queue/all_models_locked.json bytes equal final lock

all_models_adapter_sha256.frozen_canonical_BC: Map of actual entire canonical adapter directory workspace-relative filenames to freshly measured SHA256
all_models_adapter_sha256.uniform_viable_recovery: Map of actual entire trained uniform final adapter directory filenames to freshly measured SHA256
all_models_adapter_sha256.expert_recovery: Map of actual entire trained expert final adapter directory filenames to freshly measured SHA256
all_models_adapter_sha256.reference_conditional_recovery: Map of actual entire trained reference final adapter directory filenames to freshly measured SHA256

required_receipt.stages: Eight objects in frozen order: joint_token_audit, train_expert_recovery, train_uniform_viable_recovery, train_reference_conditional_recovery, eval_frozen_canonical_BC, eval_uniform_viable_recovery, eval_expert_recovery, eval_reference_conditional_recovery. Each contains exact recorded name/pid/start_ticks/owned_session and exited:true. Reject PID reuse and any live owned session member; never signal prior processes.

before_receipt: Require final queue complete/current_stage needs_astra_learning_result_review and all eight worker returncodes0/owned_cleanup_complete true.

Require all three complete training summaries100updates and all four technical evaluation summaries exactly48/48 complete with no errors. Do not parse held-out episodes, events, result or success counts.
Require full4model barrier bytes, common audit and all input/code/model/runtime inventories unchanged. Additions to any model/adapter directory fail even if all previously listed files match.
The caller supplies the review program an independently recorded receipt SHA256. Candidate/schema alone cannot serve as evidence.

offline_reviewer.portable_inputs: All local source files plus small frozen metadata, joint token audit, score/label records, training states/config/summaries/final inventories/1600exposure and101metric rows, four evaluation config/request/summary/cost/episodes/events and controllerresult. Large weights, remote originals and runtime bytes rely on the measured receipt; they need not be copied locally.
offline_reviewer.outcome_barrier: No held-out episode/event/result content until complete metadata, exits, all4model barrier, diagnostic gate review, joint score/SFT audit and all3training evidence pass. Reviewer writes durable progress marker before its first outcome read.
offline_reviewer.failure: All192 outcomes null and no contrasts on any incomplete or changed evidence. Preserve controller and reviewer unblinding states separately; false is never substituted when controller state is unknown.
offline_reviewer.complete_output: recovery_learning_result_review_passed true means complete integrity review. exploratory_practical_screen_passed is separately recomputed:reference-expert>=3 and reference-uniform>=3 and reference>frozenBC. All48 paired outcomes,6families,every scene and denominators reported; positive remains exploratory, with no automatic unseen/newseed/goal-completion claim.
